newsitem.title: USA: Repligen in pact with Pfizer.
newsitem.headline: Repligen in pact with Pfizer.

text.p: Repligen Corp said Monday it formed a collaboration with Pfizer Inc to discover small molecule immunostimulatory agents.
Repligen said it will supply reagents to Pfizer for the construction of a screening assay which will be used to screen for lead compounds in Pfizer's internal library of 500,000 compounds.
The companies will jointly evaluate any active lead compounds. Pfizer will have responsibility for the development and sale of any new therapeutic agents, Repligen said.
Repligen said it will receive an upfront technology access fee and milestone payments throughout the course of drug development. The company declined to comment on the value of the pact.
Repligen and Pfizer also have an existing joint drug discovery program to identify inhibitors of an undisclosed growth factor which was started in 1996.
